page.overview:
Who is Water Lizard Dragon?

The is the nephew of Ao Guang and usurped control over Black Water River

The Water Lizard Dragon has a square face, bright eyes, curled lips, and cinnabar-coloured hair. He wore a flower-adorned suit of iron armour and a jewelled gold helmet, and carried an iron rod segmented like bamboo.

The Water Lizard Dragon is the son of the Dragon King of Jing River, and after his father's death he was taken in by his uncle Ao Guang. Ao Guang sent him to Black Water River to learn spirit cultivation, but instead the Water Lizard Demon ousted the local river god and took it as his own.

He was able to capture the monk Tang Sanzang but posing as a boatman, and planned to eat him to become immortal. Sun Wukong informed Ao Guang of his nephew's crimes, who sent his cousin Mo'ang to arrest him.
